Original project images used by the résumé and project pages

All images below are distributed unchanged. They are displayed with contain sizing;
no circuit, data, label, or diagram has been redrawn for this site.

io-ring-layout.png
Original Cadence layout screenshot from the AMS-IO-Bench 28nm mixed-signal case.
Source: https://github.com/Arcadia-1/AMS-IO-Agent/blob/046a2e3edccd76322ab3e47c4dd9a5a1eded1e8a/AMS-IO-Bench/28nm_wirebonding/golden_output/IO_28nm_3x3_single_ring_mixed/layout_screenshot.png
This is an existing benchmark example, not a new measurement or fabricated chip photo.
No repository license was identified for this image; source attribution is retained.

folded-cascode-op-amp-pmos-cascode-loads.svg
Original Analog Canvas SVG export supplied and selected by the site owner.
Copied byte-for-byte from the supplied file on 2026-10-29.
Source: ./folded-cascode-op-amp-pmos-cascode-loads.svg
The complete original image is shown, including its original labels.
This replaces analog-folded-cascode.svg. The earlier documentation figure's
repository attribution is no longer displayed for this image.

Original ADCToolbox quickstart spectrum example.

License: MIT. Copyright (c) 2025 Zhishuai Zhang, Lu Jie.

This is a project example plot, not a claimed personal measurement.

The former locally drawn I/O ring SVG and styled Python-code illustration are
no longer rendered. Legacy unused assets remain in the local development
directory and are not included in the GitHub Pages export.

Personal photographs
zengchun-home.jpg and zengchun-profile.jpg were supplied by the site owner on
2026-10-29 for the homepage and résumé respectively. Both files are copied
